syllabus_extract: Bus bars: - Bus bar systems. Block/schematic explanation of bus bar systems, split busbar systems, concept of emergency busbar. Practical on busbar interconnection system.
specific_objectives: 13.1.2.1 Knowledge of Static converting equipment, Bus bars, cable terminations, Switches.

training_aids.remarks: Refer to the master syllabus reference list
Objective: teach the syllabus extract for this lesson

practical: Practical on busbar interconnection system. Safety precautions: Wear insulated gloves, ensure power off, verify zero voltage. Instructor supervision: Monitor connections, check for loose terminals, verify circuit continuity.
intro_questions: What is the primary function of a bus bar in an aircraft electrical system?
Name two types of bus bar systems used in aviation.
Why is the concept of an emergency bus bar critical for flight safety?

topics: Block schematic explanation of bus bar systems
development.content:
Block schematic explanation of bus bar systems
Function of static converting equipment
Cable terminations and switch integration

topics: Power distribution logic in split systems
development.content:
Split busbar systems operation
Emergency busbar concept and activation
Power distribution logic in split systems

Busbar interconnection system practical
Terminal identification and torque checks
Circuit continuity verification

summary_questions: Explain how a split busbar system isolates faults during normal operation.
Describe the role of the emergency bus bar when main power fails.
home_assignment_question: Prepare a brief note on the routing and ducting requirements for wires connected to bus bars, referencing the next lesson plan on wire types and routing.

pft_rows.syllabus: Practical and demonstration on Wires and cables: - Types of wires and cables, routing of wires and cables, open loom, ducted loom conduits, cable loom, and co-axial cables. Special purpose cables: - Ignition cables, thermocouple cables.
